subject.title: Tool outputs sometimes render as image attachments and become unreadable to the agent

question: Which open fix path should own the remaining model-visible tool-result placeholder bug before this issue can close?
rationale: The issue is valid and current main is partially fixed, but two overlapping open PRs now target the remaining media/text projection family and automation should not choose between them without maintainer intent.

options.title: Review PR 99756 as canonical
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99756 as the focused fix for this issue, refresh/review it against current main, and close this issue only after that path or an equivalent lands.

options.title: Supersede with PR 100795
options.body: Use the maintainer draft https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100795 as the broader owner if it intentionally covers both this issue and the adjacent session/media-block reports.

options.title: Keep investigating payload capture
options.body: Leave both PRs unlanded until a live provider-visible payload capture proves exactly where text is dropped in an affected session.

recommendation.title: Review PR 99756 as canonical
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99756 as the focused fix for this issue, refresh/review it against current main, and close this issue only after that path or an equivalent lands.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent refactor ownership of the AI runtime package makes this the best available routing owner for deciding the provider-surface landing path.
